hero.headline: Albemarle has the pieces. Let’s give it a *story.*
hero.lead: Your economic development strategic plan calls for a bold investment brand that tells Albemarle’s innovation story to site selectors, business leaders, and the media. Hallpass can help turn that ambition into a story people see, remember, and act on.

photo.alt: A cider maker pours a glass for a guest in a sunlit field in Albemarle County

concepts.headline: Make Albemarle’s innovation story *visible.*
concepts.lead: A connected editorial system, not one-off posts, could give site selectors, business leaders, emerging talent, and media multiple ways into the same Albemarle story.

plan.quote: A bold, coordinated brand will help the county define its value proposition, communicate clearly with site selectors and business leaders, and give local partners a *shared story to tell.*
plan.quote_source: Albemarle County Economic Development Strategic Plan 2025–2030, adopted August 13, 2025, Strategy 5.7, p. 73
plan.outside_help_quote: One of the plan’s own findings: “Albemarle County is doing the work, but too often, the story of that work is lost in the noise” (p. 24). Strategy 5.7 calls for activating the brand “through marketing materials and digital platforms” (p. 73).

pov.people_line: We start with people: the life sciences founder scaling up in Albemarle, the cider maker turning heirloom apples into a growing business, the engineer who chose a career near Rivanna Station.
